Corollary
[normal Jacobi fields with zero initial value]

↗ prop:dc-ch5-3-6 ↗ rem:dc-ch5-3-2

1. ch5:3.8Suppose $J(0)=0$. Then $\langle J'(0),\gamma '(0)\rangle =0$ if and only if $\langle J(t),\gamma '(t)\rangle =0$ for every $t$. If $\dim M=n$ and $\gamma $ is nonconstant, the space of such Jacobi fields has dimension $n-1$.
Proof

\sketch By section 2, the pairing is $t\langle J'(0),\gamma '(0)\rangle $. Under the identification $J\mapsto J'(0)$, the normal fields form the hyperplane $\gamma '(0)^\perp \subset T_{\gamma (0)}M$.

□
